name: Strike Witches: Anata to Dekiru Koto - A Little Peaceful Days
original_name: ストライクウィッチーズ あなたとできること A Little Peaceful Days
source:
One day, the world is invaded by a monster called "Neuroi". One and only hope for the humans is the "Strike Witches". The witches are sent to an isolated island for exercises. However, they are attacked by Neuroi on their way to the island! Since the aircraft carrier gets damaged, it leaves them on the island and returns to the base. Therefore, they will need to stay on the island until the support arms join them....

translation:
一天，名为“涅洛伊”的怪物入侵了世界。人类唯一的希望是“强袭魔女”。魔女们被派往一座孤岛进行演习，却在前往岛屿途中遭到涅洛伊袭击！航空母舰受损，只得把她们留在岛上，独自返回基地。因此，在支援部队抵达前，她们必须一直留在岛上…
